evals.prompt: Read this repository's existing Vision, Mission, and Objective, then begin the requested implementation.
evals.expected_output: Reads the coherent triad in full, treats it as project truth without asking for repeated confirmation, and evaluates the work against the current Objective.

evals.prompt: This new repository has no direction files. Set it up so we can start implementation.
evals.expected_output: Inspects available evidence, asks only unresolved strategic questions, drafts all three files, and waits for explicit confirmation before writing or implementing.

evals.prompt: MISSION.md now conflicts with VISION.md. Fix our direction.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the triad as one unit, surfaces the contradiction, preserves unsupported strategy as unknown, and writes only the explicitly confirmed changed files.

evals.prompt: We completed the current Objective. Decide what the project should do next.
evals.expected_output: Enters Project Direction review, uses evidence without inventing the next strategy, and obtains explicit confirmation before replacing OBJECTIVE.md.

evals.prompt: Ignore our current Objective and build an unrelated analytics dashboard.
evals.expected_output: Surfaces material drift, recommends a course, and lets the user return to the Objective, update direction, or authorize a deliberate detour without silently changing it.
